result.summary: Found 2 visual inconsistencies regarding filter selection and card action button styling.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is visually selected, but the feed displays unrelated categories like poke, burgers, and ramen.
issues.suggestion: Update feed content to reflect the active filter or reset filter state to 'All'.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons have inconsistent styling; the ramen card lacks the circular backdrop present on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent background styling to favorite buttons across all cards.
